title: ‘Beef’ Breakout Seoyeon Jang Accidentally Manifested Her Role in Season 2 of the Netflix Hit
summary: The 31-year-old British-Korean actress, who got her start as a K-pop idol trainee turned K-drama star, loves how messy the Netflix anthology characters get to be: “We all have these petty sides to ourselves, and it’s very refreshing to see these characters amplify that pettiness.”
